stories.title: Token Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define canonical bearer token schema (hashed_token_id, issued_at, expires_at, scope, status) and validation contract enforced across GPTReader and Azure Functions.

stories.title: Core Token Lifecycle Engine
stories.description: Implement backend logic for token issuance, expiration enforcement, and rotation with invalidation of prior tokens and overlap handling.

stories.title: Token Management Interfaces
stories.description: Expose internal APIs or functions for token issuance, validation, rotation, and revocation to support GPTReader and pipeline services.

stories.title: Lifecycle Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate token lifecycle validation into GPTReader request flow, enforcing expiration, revocation, and scope checks on every request.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, and invalid token rejection across GPTReader and pipeline flows.
